display_long_description:
**A neon archery roguelite where you fly.** Skate, leap and shoot in mid-air while a living black hole pours its swarm down on the last city still lit. **The first five levels are free, and joining a DUO opens the whole game.**

**A real bow, in mid-air.** Draw, aim, release. Arrows ricochet off everything and curve toward their targets. Slow time for the impossible shot.

**Move like nothing else in VR.** Sweep your arms to skate a neon rooftop arena. Launch off the lip, chain air jumps and dive-slam into the horde.

**Throw black holes.** Drag the horde into one knot, then shoot into it for a devastating blast.

**Builds that break the screen.** 63 stacking items: burning tips, homing rockets, chain lightning, echo shots, meteor storms. Open legendary chests, but watch for the ones that bite.

**No two levels alike.** Low gravity, giants and gold rushes change the rules. Chase the Gold Thief, then climb past Wardens and Overlords to THE ECLIPSE, tearing the city into the sky.

**DUO online co-op.** Quick Join or bring a friend. Free players can join any host and play the host's full game, ECLIPSE included.

**Always something to earn.** Open cases of looks for your bow, arrows and robot, and chase daily contracts and trophies. Cases are earned only, never sold.

**Free to start.** One unlock opens solo past level five and DUO hosting. One-time purchase, no ads.

Synthwave soundtrack that rises with the fight. Plays offline after the first launch; DUO needs internet.
